## Abandoned cart — current vs proposed

| Step | Timing | Current | Proposed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cart 1 | 45 minutes | 4 hours, 'Did you forget something?' | 45 minutes, product name in the subject, no discount |
| Cart 2 | 22 hours | 24 hours, generic 10% off code | 22 hours, no extra discount, answer the objection instead |
| Cart 3 | 46 hours | 72 hours, 'last chance' | 46 hours, lands before Monday midnight |

**Cart 1 copy —** Subject: Your Night Repair Serum is still in your cart. Body: one line that the cart is saved, one line that the 20% is already applied and there is no code to find, one link back. No image of the product they just looked at.

**Cart 2 copy —** Subject: A question we get about Night Repair. Body: the three-sentence answer to 'will this sting', the returns line, one link. A second discount during BFCM teaches the customer that the first price was not real.

**Cart 3 copy —** Subject: Your cart closes with the sale. Body: the real deadline, the free mini if they are over $85, and one sentence that this is the last email about it. Then it is.

## Setup checklist (you do this, ~40 minutes)

1. Duplicate your main campaign folder before importing: Klaviyo → Campaigns → Templates, keep the originals untouched.
2. Create the segment 'BFCM 2026 — non-buyers': everyone who has not placed an order since 2026-11-26 00:00.
3. Create the segment 'E1 non-openers' for the 24 hours after E1 sends; E2 targets that segment plus anyone added since.
4. Suppression: exclude 'Placed Order since 2026-11-26' from E3, E4 and E5 so nobody who bought gets a discount email.
5. Set the sitewide 20% as an automatic discount in Shopify, not a code. Confirm at checkout on a $32 item that it reads $25.60 and that it does not stack on the two bundles.
6. Add the free-gift rule as a Shopify automatic discount: order value over $85 adds the 10ml Barrier Balm mini, one per order, while inventory lasts.
7. Import the CSV into Klaviyo as a campaign template set; check that the subject and preview fields landed and that the body is HTML, not raw markdown.
8. Send all 8 messages to yourself first. Check mobile, check the links, check that the opt-out line renders.
9. Turn off any old abandoned-cart discount code before Cart 2 goes live, or a buyer can stack it on the 20%.
10. Have the reply inbox staffed for the weekend — at least one person checking twice a day, because every email invites a reply.

## Claims and compliance

- Every product claim in this pack came from your own product pages. If a claim is not on your site, it is not in this pack.
- No invented reviews, no invented scarcity, no revenue guarantees, no countdown timers that reset.
- The opt-out line is in every email and every SMS, and it is honoured on reply without a follow-up.
